title: Pilot Message
help: Dellal, your AI salesperson, answers customers on WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and TikTok, gives prices, stock and delivery, and takes orders (they arrive in Confirmation). You can take over any conversation at any time.
off: {{name}} is off: messages arrive here but nobody answers automatically.

inbox.pickHint: Messages from WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and TikTok arrive here.

thread.window24: More than 24 hours since the customer’s last message: Meta no longer lets the shop answer here. You can answer as soon as the customer writes again.
thread.modeHuman: You answer this customer: {{name}} is paused here.

tester.title: Try {{name}}
tester.help: Talk to {{name}} like a customer. It uses your real products, stock and delivery fees. Orders are only simulated.
tester.demoPreview: Preview: these answers come from a demo seller. On your server, with the AI key, Claude answers.
tester.demoNoKey: Demo answers: add the AI key in Settings so {{name}} answers with Claude.
tester.demoPilot: Demo answers: Pilotix’s AI is not on yet. As soon as Pilotix turns it on, {{name}} answers with Claude.
tester.inPage: In this page, {{name}} answers with Claude (your Claude account), with its real instructions, the demo's products and delivery fees, and the Darija check. A reply often takes 20 to 60 seconds.

results.title: {{name}}'s results
results.note: {{name}}'s orders follow the normal flow (confirmation, depot, delivery) and also count in the other statistics.

settings.enabledHint: Off: messages arrive in the inbox, without automatic answers.
settings.name: Agent name
settings.ordersNew: Confirmation › New (an agent calls before shipping)
settings.followUp: Follow up when the customer goes quiet
settings.followUpHint: One follow-up only, inside the 24 h WhatsApp and Messenger allow.
settings.autoOrderHint: The customer gave their number, then stopped answering: after this time, {{name}} sends their order to Confirmation › New with the number and the product they asked about, and the team calls them.
settings.modelHint: Sonnet: the right balance. Haiku: cheaper. Opus: the sharpest.
settings.nightHint: Otherwise night messages wait for the team in the morning.
settings.discountHint: Never above the product's maximum discount (Products).
settings.knowsHelp: {{name}} reads your products, variants, prices, stock, delivery fees and the customer's history by itself. Add here what is nowhere else.
settings.notesHint: Warranty, sizes, delays, exchanges, opening hours…
settings.notesPh: E.g.: 6-month warranty on strollers. Delivery in 24 to 72 h. Exchange possible within 3 days.
settings.handoff: Hand over to the team when…
settings.handoffHint: One reason per line. It also hands over when the customer is upset.
settings.serviceHint: When {{name}} can’t answer, it asks for the customer’s number so a team member calls them. If the customer doesn’t give it after two asks, {{name}} gives them this number.
settings.serviceNone: Empty, with no after-sales number in Settings › Shop: someone from the team answers in the conversation.
settings.aiHelp: Dellal uses Claude (Anthropic). Create a key on console.anthropic.com: you pay Anthropic per message, usually a few dinars per conversation.
settings.aiNone: Without a key, {{name}} answers with the demo seller (simple rules).
settings.channelsHelp: In your Meta app (developers.facebook.com), add the WhatsApp and Messenger products, paste the address and token below in Webhooks, and subscribe to “messages”. Meta must review the app (a few days).
settings.tiktokHelp: TikTok opens its messaging only to approved business accounts. Once you have access (or through a relay tool), send the messages to this address.
settings.demo: Demo: channels do not receive real messages.
settings.darijaHelp: Before sending, {{name}} checks its message: Moroccan, Tunisian, Libyan, Egyptian or Middle-Eastern words, wrong phrases and your banned list are corrected automatically.
settings.darijaIntro: Have an Algerian seller from your team fill these two lists: that is what makes {{name}}'s Darija truly natural.
settings.darijaPreferHint: One per line: your own phrases, as you write them to customers.
settings.darijaPreferPh:
Mar7ba bik / biki
Saha khouya / khti
Tkhalles ki testalem
Bla mziya
settings.darijaAvoidHint: One per line. Put the right word after an arrow: “frero → khouya”.

v.001Hint: Takes the first name, number, wilaya and product, notes what the customer wants and puts the order in Confirmation › New: the team calls to confirm. If the customer changes anything, {{name}} updates the order.
v.fullHint: Takes the whole order in the chat: commune, home or office delivery, recap, extra sale. Can send it straight to the depot.

settings.pageVia: Linked by the account “{{account}}” in Pilot AI › Accounts.
settings.pageNoneHint: Link your Facebook account: your agents then answer on Messenger and Instagram.
settings.pageOld: An old Page key pasted by hand still works. Link your Facebook account: it will be replaced.
settings.waHelp: WhatsApp still goes through your own Meta app: paste its address and verify token in Webhooks, then its secret key below.
settings.igLoginHelp: Without Meta’s approval, Instagram lets {{name}} answer only accounts that have a role on the Meta app. With Instagram’s own login, your own Instagram account is added to the app: {{name}} can then answer all its customers.
settings.igStep1: In the Meta app, give your Instagram account the Instagram Tester role:
settings.igStep2: Make your account’s key (log in with your Instagram account) and copy it:
settings.igStep3: Paste the key here and save. Never send it to anyone, not even in a chat.
settings.igStep1b: then accept the invite in Instagram:
settings.igStepNote: A system user’s key (Business settings › System users, with your Instagram account and the instagram_manage_messages permission) works too, and never ends.
settings.photosHint: When a customer asks for a photo, {{name}} sends the product’s real photos (the colour asked first). It also looks at the photos customers send.

lahja.fixHelp: The message that was sent does not change: write how {{name}} should have said it. The words you change become a lesson.
lahja.added: Darija lesson added: Dellal uses it now in your shop.
lahja.addedPilotix: Darija lesson added: Dellal uses it now in your shop, and Pilotix checks it for every shop.
lahja.doneWaiting: Used now in your shop · sent to Pilotix
lahja.title: Darija lessons
lahja.help: How {{name}} should speak Darija. Under one of {{name}}'s messages, tap « Darija lesson » and write it the right way: the changed words become a lesson, used at once in your shop. Pilotix checks them: an accepted lesson serves every shop.
lahja.empty: No lesson yet. In a conversation, tap « Darija lesson » under one of {{name}}'s messages.

review.accepted: Accepted by Pilotix: soon in every shop

lahja.learnedEmpty: Nothing yet: every night, {{name}} looks at how your customers write.
lahja.learnedNote: {{name}} already uses them in your shop; Pilotix decides if every shop keeps them.
lahja.allEmpty: No lesson for every shop yet.
